meta.description: Filters germline and somatic variant callsets at the site and genotype level with GATK VQSR (VQSLOD, truth-sensitivity tranches), VETS/ScoreVariantAnnotations, NVScoreVariants, hard filters with per-annotation thresholds, and bcftools/cyvcf2 expressions, plus Ti/Tv-based QC. Use when deciding between VQSR, hard filtering, and ML recalibration by cohort size and platform, setting SNP vs indel thresholds, replicating the missing-annotation-passes rule so hom-alt sites survive, applying genotype-level GQ/DP filters, or validating filter impact. Not for VCF normalization (see variant-calling/variant-normalization) or summary statistics (see variant-calling/vcf-statistics).
meta.execution_note: Mode A. Windows: bcftools 1.24 (MSYS2 build, plugins via BCFTOOLS_PLUGINS) and GATK 4.6.1.0 (OpenJDK 17); WSL agents distro (files passed by tar, no drive mount): bcftools 1.21, cyvcf2 0.34.0. Data SYNTHETIC (data/make_data.py, seed 20260911): 8-sample raw joint callset, 361 sites with planted truth in data/cohort_truth_classes.tsv (240 true SNPs, 25 hom-alt-only true sites, 20 true indels, 6 excess-het paralog sites, 60 artifact SNPs, 10 artifact indels), plus SYNTHETIC DeepVariant-shaped (runs/in6) and Mutect2-shaped (runs/in7) VCFs. Not executed: FilterMutectCalls itself (needs Mutect2 stats/contamination tables; flags checked with --help), VETS and NVScoreVariants (no model/GPU). Inputs executed: 7/7. Layer-1 avg 34.6/40, Layer-2 avg 50.6/60, assertion pass rate 23/28 (82%). Grade note: Production Ready floor not met (assertions): downgraded one tier.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or values in outputs; references (DePristo 2011, Van der Auwera 2013, Poplin 2018, Danecek 2021) are real and correctly attributed.

practice_boundaries.detail: Callset QC only; no individual-level interpretation.

methodological_ground.detail: Method guidance verified on planted truth (hard filters kept 285/285 true sites; the VQSR-on-small-panel failure the Skill warns about was reproduced).

code_usability.detail: GATK, bcftools and cyvcf2 blocks ran. Three snippets (example concat, FMT/AF[0], usage-guide AD[1]) fail loudly with explicit bcftools errors; recorded as P1/P2, not silent wrong results.

functional_suitability.note: VQSR/hard-filter/genotype guidance verified: GATK VariantFiltration with the SKILL.md thresholds kept 240/240 true SNPs, 25/25 hom-alt, 20/20 true indels and 8/70 artifacts; the guarded bcftools expression reproduced the GATK SNP PASS set exactly. Three shipped snippets fail: examples/filter_variants.sh aborts at bcftools concat on any multi-chromosome input, and the somatic FMT/AF[0] and usage-guide AD[1]/(AD[0]+AD[1]) expressions are rejected by bcftools 1.21 and 1.24 (Number=A/R tags need [sample:subfield]).

reliability.note: Common Errors table maps hom-alt loss, VQSR non-convergence and empty output to fixes; it misses the concat-contiguity and subfield-index errors the Skill's own code triggers.

agent_usability.note: Governing principle (site vs genotype, SNP vs indel, missing=>PASS) is exactly what an agent needs; the cyvcf2 block is presented as the Python counterpart but omits QD/SOR/RankSum terms (kept 26/60 artifacts vs 4/60).

human_usability.note: Natural prompts in usage guide; method-selection table readable.

security.note: Local files only; no credentials; no destructive commands.

maintainability.note: Modular sections; the shipped example is broken for multi-contig input and no test data ships to catch it.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger with hand-offs to normalization and vcf-statistics; DL-caller and somatic escape hatches explicit.

recommendations.title: Shipped filter_variants.sh fails on multi-contig input
recommendations.problem: bcftools concat without -a aborts ("chromosome block chr1 is not contiguous") whenever the SNP and indel files span more than one chromosome, so the script never writes its merged output.
recommendations.root_cause: concat is applied to two position-interleaved, unindexed files.
recommendations.fix: Index both filtered files and use `bcftools concat -a`; verified that the script then produces the same PASS set as GATK.

recommendations.title: Somatic post-filter uses invalid, wrong-sample indexing
recommendations.problem: `FMT/AF[0]>0.05` is rejected for Number=A AF, and the obvious fix AF[0:0] filters the first sample column, which is the normal in tumor-normal VCFs listing the normal first.
recommendations.root_cause: Sample and subfield indexing were not tested on a two-sample Mutect2 VCF.
recommendations.fix: Use `FMT/AF[T:0]` with T taken from `bcftools query -l` or the ##tumor_sample header (or `bcftools view -s TUMOR` first) and state which column is tested.

recommendations.title: Usage-guide allele-balance expression does not parse
recommendations.root_cause: Number=R FORMAT tag indexed without sample:subfield.

recommendations.title: cyvcf2 block is not equivalent to the hard filter
recommendations.problem: The Python block checks only QUAL/DP/FS/MQ and kept 26/60 artifacts where the bcftools/GATK filter kept 4.
recommendations.root_cause: Presented as the Python counterpart but omits QD, SOR and RankSum terms.
recommendations.fix: Add QD, SOR and None-guarded RankSum checks, or label the block a minimal example.

recommendations.title: Common Errors table misses the Skill's own failure modes
recommendations.problem: The concat-contiguity and "multiple subfields" errors hit by the Skill's code are not in the table.
recommendations.root_cause: Table written from generic experience rather than running the recipes.
recommendations.fix: Add rows for both errors with the fixes above.
